skills.name: Blue Blaster
skills.description: Breathes blue flame. Bad effects on enemies.  *Continuously cancels enemy invincibility (4 sec) *ATK x 3600% Area Damage  *Makes enemy skills unusable (6 sec)

skills.name: A Wonderful Sound
skills.description: Yamato plays his harmonica. Good effects on allies.  *Skill Hit Rate +40% (7 sec) *Skill Use Rate +50%  (7 sec) *Move Speed +190% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Digimon Adventure
abilities.description: Digimon Adventure Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy Silence: Strength
abilities.description: Has a high chance of making all Strength type enemies' Skills unusable and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
